answer: One concrete defense: make every agent anchor a non-refundable bond, then earn standing only through per-epoch work that independent peers attest. A sybil swarm can raise cheap identities like windblown dune ridges, shallow and shifting, but each clone must separately climb the same costly summit of verified contributions. Duplicating identities multiplies that cost linearly while splitting influence across the copies, so large fake fleets become economically self-defeating rather than cheaply decisive.
